thread:
Samira (Sales Eng): Heads-up, Greenline asked for a 2-week private POC inside their US VPC. Requirements: 4 GPU baseline (A100-equivalent), burst up to 8 GPUs for busy windows, SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM option, and a capability matrix + RFI answers. They want a non-binding quote by EOD tomorrow.

Alex (AE): Copy. Do they require contractual data residency guarantees or just an operational statement? Need an order-of-magnitude cost too.

Samira (Sales Eng): They want contract clause: US-only processing and deletion of logs with 30-day retention for PII. Include that in the quote.

Priya (SRE): We can run a private trial via our Private flow. ETA for basic peering + infra ~48 hours. HSM/KMS integration adds 5-7 days and an SOW. Minimal steps for Greenline infra team:
```
# run from Greenline bastion
curl -X POST https://peering.redwood.ai/v1/request -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"cidr":"10.52.0.0/20","env":"greenline-trial"}'
# we'll return peering config and an agent image URL
```
I'll need their contact, CIDR, and target windows for burst.

Ben (Solutions): Uploaded two attachments to the shared drive: greenline_matrix_v1.xlsx and greenline_rfi_answers_v1.pdf. Matrix highlights: model catalog (open + fine-tune options), quantization profiles, KV prefix caching, routing/fallback tiers, and telemetry. Included a sample RFI writeup for HSM and SOC2.

Alex (AE): For pricing, propose promotional trial: 50% off compute for first 2 weeks and waive onboarding. Samira ok with that?

Samira (Sales Eng): Yes. Provide line-items: reserved baseline (4 GPUs) monthly equivalent prorated for 2 weeks, burst per-GPU-hour, network/egress per TB. Make the quote non-binding.

Priya (SRE): Quick ballpark (non-binding): reserved baseline (4xA100-eq) ~ $18k/mo committed; burst ~ $15/GPU-hour; egress ~$0.09/GB. With 50% off compute for 2-week trial, estimate ~$2.2k - $2.6k depending on burst usage. HSM onboarding + SOW is extra and adds lead time.

Ben (Solutions): SOC2 Type II report available; will attach redacted copy. For KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS; optional HSM requires addendum + engineering work. Documented in the RFI answers.

Alex (AE): I'll draft the email with the capability matrix, RFI answers, and the non-binding quote. Samira, can you confirm Greenline contact?

Samira (Sales Eng): Jordan contact: jordan@greenline.com. CIDR: 10.52.0.0/20. Jordan asked for a minimal deploy snippet for their infra team. Priya can you paste a tiny example they can run?

Priya (SRE): Sure, minimal agent bootstrap example:
```bash
# on Greenline bastion
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env greenline-trial --cidr 10.52.0.0/20
# agent will create peering, register nodes, and report back to our control plane
```
I'll follow up with MFA/KMS steps in email thread.

Samira (Sales Eng): Great. I'll attach Ben's files + SOC2 redacted + the quote. Alex, please add the promo terms and trial limits.

Alex (AE): Approved. Commercial notes: trial limited to 14 days, support at trial tier, burst capped at 8 GPUs, any extended retention or additional SLAs will need a contract amendment.

deploy-bot: Trial workspace queued: "greenline-trial". Provisioning ETA ~46 hours. :rocket:

Samira (Sales Eng): Thanks all — I'll send as soon as I add the CIDR + snippet. Jordan said they'd be ready to kick off as soon as they see the attachments.
